get.summary: Health check handler. Always returns 200 OK.
List runs with optional filtering and pagination.
get.description:
# Query Parameters

- `workflow` — Filter by workflow name (optional)
- `status` — Filter by run status (optional)
- `created_by` — Filter by author user ID (optional). Also matches runs
  triggered by one of that user's API keys.
- `page` — Page number, 1-based (default: 1)
- `per_page` — Items per page (default: 20, max: 100)

parameters.name: has_steps
parameters.description:
Filter by step presence (only applies to completed/cancelled runs).
Non-terminal runs (pending, running, etc.) are always included.
When `true`, only return completed/cancelled runs that have steps.
When `false`, only return completed/cancelled runs without steps.

parameters.name: created_by
parameters.description:
Filter by author: the user ID that triggered the run.

Also matches runs triggered by one of that user's API keys.

post.description:
Returns 201 Created with the newly enqueued run.

An optional `Idempotency-Key` header makes the call safe to replay: the same
key returns the run it already produced with 200 OK instead of enqueueing a
second one. A key reused with a different workflow or payload is rejected with
409 Conflict. Keys stay bound for 24 hours, after which they are released.

# Errors

Returns [`ApiError::Forbidden`] for non-admin callers.
Returns [`ApiError::BadRequest`] if the workflow is unknown, the body is
invalid, or the `Idempotency-Key` header is malformed.
Returns [`ApiError::IdempotencyKeyConflict`] if the key is bound to a
different request.
Returns [`ApiError::MonthlyBudgetExceeded`] if the global monthly cost quota
is exhausted.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Optional key making the call safe to replay. At most 255 printable ASCII characters, valid for 24 hours.

200.description: Idempotency key replayed: the existing run is returned

400.description: Unknown workflow, invalid body or malformed Idempotency-Key

409.description: Idempotency key already used with a different request

get.summary: Get a run by ID, including all its steps and dependency edges.
get.description: Returns 404 if the run does not exist.

post.summary: Approve a run that is awaiting human approval.
post.description:
Transitions the run from `AwaitingApproval` back to `Running`.
Returns 400 if the run is not in `AwaitingApproval` state.

post.summary: Cancel a pending or running run.
post.description:
Transitions the run to `Cancelled` status. Returns 400 if the run
is already in a terminal state.

post.summary: Reject a run that is awaiting human approval.
post.description:
Transitions the run from `AwaitingApproval` to `Failed`.
Returns 400 if the run is not in `AwaitingApproval` state.

Creates a new `Pending` run with `TriggerKind::Retry` pointing to the
original. Returns 400 if the run is not in a retryable state, 409 if an
automatic retry is already armed, and 409 if the handler version has
changed since the original run (pass `?force=true` to override).

parameters.name: force
parameters.description: Force retry despite handler version mismatch

409.description: Version mismatch or automatic retry already armed

get.summary: Download one artifact produced by a step.
get.description:
Streams the stored bytes with the MIME type recorded at upload time. The
artifact must belong to both the run and the step named in the path, so an
id guessed from another run resolves to a 404 rather than a leak.

Requires the same permission as reading the run itself.

404.description: Run, step or artifact not found

get.description: Returns key, id, and timestamps. Never returns encrypted or decrypted values.

post.summary: Create or update a secret. Admin only.
post.description:
If the key already exists, the value is replaced. The response
never includes the secret value.

get.summary: Report how the configured key ring lines up with the stored secrets.
get.description:
This is what tells an operator whether an old key can be dropped from
`IRONFLOW_SECRET_KEYS` without breaking the next startup: a version listed
in `retirable` is configured, not active, and used by no secret.

A non-empty `missing` means some stored secrets cannot be decrypted with
the current configuration -- the server refuses to start in that state.

# Errors

- 401 if the caller is not authenticated
- 403 if the caller is not an admin

post.summary: Re-encrypt one batch of secrets towards a key version. Admin only.
post.description:
One call processes one batch, so a rotation over a large stock never
becomes a single long request. The client loops, passing `last_id` back as
`after_id`, until `remaining` reaches zero or `last_id` comes back null.

The operation is idempotent: secrets already on the target version are
skipped, so an interrupted rotation can simply be restarted.

# Errors

- 400 if the target version is not in the configured key ring
- 401 if the caller is not authenticated
- 403 if the caller is not an admin

requestBody.description: Target key version, batch size, and resume cursor

ApiKeyResponse.description: API key summary (never includes the hash or raw key).

ApiKeyScope.description:
Permission scope for an API key.

Each scope grants access to a specific set of actions.
A key with no scopes has no permissions.

name.description: File name, unique within the step.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the content.

size_bytes.description: Size of the content, in bytes.

run_id.description: Associated run ID, if the event is run-scoped.

step_id.description: Associated step ID, if the event is step-scoped.

user_id.description: Associated user ID, if the event is user-scoped.

CreateApiKeyRequest.description: Request body for creating an API key.

CreateApiKeyResponse.description:
Response returned when creating an API key.
The raw key is only shown once.

key.description: The full raw API key (only returned at creation time).

labels.description: Optional key-value labels for categorization and filtering.

max_cost_usd.description:
Optional cumulative cost cap for this run, in USD.

Overrides the workflow default and the server default. `None` falls back
to those. Must be zero or positive.

max_retries.description:
How many times the run may be replayed automatically after a transient
failure. Defaults to `0`, meaning no automatic retry.

Each retry waits an exponential backoff (30 s, 2 min, 8 min, capped at
15 min) before the run is replayed from the start. Failures that cannot
succeed on replay -- an unknown workflow, an invalid payload, an
exhausted agent budget, a rejected approval, a manual cancellation --
consume no attempt.

payload.description: Optional input payload for the workflow.

scheduled_at.description: Optional deferred execution time. `None` means run immediately.

CreateUserRequest.description: Request body for creating a user (admin only).

is_admin.description: Whether the new user should be an admin.

id.description:
Identifier of the principal: the user ID, the API key ID, or `None` for
[`CreatedByKind::System`].

kind.description: What kind of principal triggered the run.

label.description:
Human-readable label. Never empty.

The username for a user, `"key-name (username)"` for an API key, and the
trigger description for a system run.

CreatedByKind.description: What kind of principal triggered a run.

oneOf.description: A new run was created (status: Pending).
A run changed status.

cost_usd.description: Aggregated cost in USD at the time of transition.

duration_ms.description: Aggregated duration in milliseconds at the time of transition.

labels.description: Labels of the run at the time of the transition.

oneOf.description:
A run transitioned to [`Failed`](ironflow_store::models::RunStatus::Failed).

This is a convenience event emitted alongside [`RunStatusChanged`](Event::RunStatusChanged)
when the target status is `Failed`. Subscribe to this instead of
`RUN_STATUS_CHANGED` when you only care about failures.

cost_usd.description: Aggregated cost in USD at the time of failure.

duration_ms.description: Aggregated duration in milliseconds at the time of failure.

labels.description: Labels of the run at the time of the failure.

oneOf.description:
A run was stopped because it reached its cumulative cost cap.

Emitted when the engine refuses an agent step that would cross the run's
`max_cost_usd`. The run transitions to
[`Cancelled`](ironflow_store::models::RunStatus::Cancelled) and the step
is never launched, so the reported spend is what the run had already
consumed.

limit_usd.description: The configured cost cap in USD.

spent_usd.description: Cost already consumed when the cap was reached, in USD.

step_budget_usd.description: Declared budget of the refused step, in USD.

oneOf.description:
A manual retry was forced despite a handler version mismatch.

Emitted when a caller passes `force=true` on a retry where the
handler version differs from the run's recorded version. This is
an audit event: it means the new code will execute on the old
payload without the handler explicitly declaring compatibility.

original_version.description: Version stored on the original run.

run_id.description: The new run created by the forced retry.

oneOf.description: A step completed successfully.
A step failed.
A run is waiting for human approval.
A run was approved by a human.
A run was rejected by a human.

A log line emitted during step execution.

Pushed by the worker in real time so that SSE clients can stream
step output as it happens, without waiting for step completion.
A user signed in.
A new user signed up.
A user signed out.

RotateSecretsRequest.description:
Request body for rotating a batch of secrets to another key version.

Rotation is driven one batch per call so a long rotation never becomes a
long HTTP request: the client loops, carrying `after_id` forward.

after_id.description: Resume after this secret ID. Omit to start from the beginning.

batch_size.description: Secrets to process in this batch. Defaults to 100, clamped to 1000.

to_version.description: Target key version. Defaults to the server's active version.

failed.description: Secrets skipped because they could not be decrypted.

last_id.description:
Highest secret ID seen in this batch. Pass it back as `after_id` to
continue; `null` means there is nothing left to do.

remaining.description: Secrets left on another key version after this batch.

rotated.description: Secrets successfully re-encrypted in this batch.

to_version.description: Key version the batch re-encrypted towards.

RunDetailResponse.description: Run detail response — includes steps and payload.

payload.description: Input payload that triggered this run.

RunResponse.description:
Run response DTO — public API representation of a run.

Maps from the internal [`Run`] model, exposing only necessary fields.

# Examples

```
use ironflow_store::models::{Run, RunStatus, TriggerKind};
use ironflow_api::entities::RunResponse;
```

created_by.description: Who triggered the run. Always present.

handler_version.description: Version of the handler that created this run.

idempotency_key.description: Idempotency key that produced this run, when one was supplied.

max_cost_usd.description: Cumulative cost cap for this run, in USD. `None` means no cap.

scheduled_at.description: Scheduled execution time. `None` means the run executed immediately.

ScopeEntry.description: A scope entry with its machine name and human-readable label.

SecretResponse.description: Response DTO for a secret (never exposes the value).

SetSecretRequest.description: Request body for creating or updating a secret.

value.description: Secret value (plaintext, will be encrypted at rest).

StatsResponse.description:
Aggregate statistics response.

Computed from all runs in the store.

# Examples

```
use ironflow_api::entities::StatsResponse;
```

active_runs.description: Number of pending or running runs.

success_rate_percent.description: Success rate: completed / (completed + failed), as a percentage.

total_cost_usd.description: Aggregated cost across all runs in USD.

total_duration_ms.description: Aggregated duration across all runs in milliseconds.

artifacts.description:
Files this step produced, downloadable through the artifact route.

Empty when the step produced none or when artifact storage is not
configured on the server.

attempt.description:
Which run attempt produced this step (1-based).

A run retried twice exposes steps with `attempt` 1, 2 and 3. Steps from
earlier attempts are kept so a failed attempt stays inspectable.

debug_messages.description:
Verbose conversation trace for agent steps (thinking blocks, tool
calls, tool results, per-turn usage). `None` when verbose mode was
off or the step is not an agent step.

dependencies.description: IDs of steps this step depends on (direct dependencies).

SubWorkflowDetail.description: Sub-workflow detail included in the workflow response.

source_code.description: Optional Rust source code of the handler.

oneOf.description: Triggered manually (CLI or programmatic call).
Triggered by an incoming webhook.

path.description: The webhook path that received the request.

oneOf.description: Triggered by a cron schedule.
Triggered via the REST API.
Retry of a previously failed run.
Triggered by a parent workflow as a sub-workflow step.
Triggered by a message consumed from a NATS subject.

subject.description: The NATS subject the message was consumed from.

oneOf.description: Triggered by an internal run event (workflow chaining).

source_run_id.description: The run whose event triggered this run.

category.description: Optional `/`-separated category path used to group workflows.
